from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class CompanyEquity(BaseModel):
    """Owner's equity information from one company's financial report"""
    company_name: str | None = Field(description="Name of the company as reported in the document")
    equity_label: str | None = Field(description="The label used for the equity field in the report")
    equity_amount: str | None = Field(description="The equity amount as reported (string format for downstream comparison)")
    period: str | None = Field(description="The reporting period, e.g., '2024年第一季度'")
    quote: str = Field(description="Brief verbatim excerpt anchoring the extracted data")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    company_equities: list[CompanyEquity]
